chapter: The rhythm section, family and records
title: Hinton asks about Walter Page; Jones says nothing exists without him
summary: Page is the one member of the section who has died, and Jones says without him no one would have heard of Rushing, Lester Young or Jo Jones.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now here it is 1973 and fate has it that the only one of you in all that time, which is quite unusual for a rhythm section - only one of you has been lost to - given to the ages and that was Walter Page. So tell me a little about him because he's not here to speak. I can ask Basie
and I can talk to you, I can ask Freddie Green, but you tell me about Walter.

Without Mr. Walter Page you would never have heard of Hot Lips Page; you would never heard of Jimmy Rushing; you would never have heard of Lester Young; you would never have heard of Jo Jones; you would have never heard of Charlie Parker because Buster Smith is there and he's still alive. You could not get that out of that.
